name: fix100_kliff
verifies: fix-100 (owner: 'I brought the smith Kliff to Javier but the quest won't finish'): the whole Kliff quest on its real path without moving anyone: Javier_BringSmith from Javier, Kliff's duties, Kliff_FreeHim from Topork, Kliff freed, Kliff_BringHimToJavierJavier, the hero's SlaveJoin topic, 'wait here' and 'follow me' again (CP: a waiting slave is offered SlaveJoin again; ours offered nothing and the owner could not get Kliff to follow any more), the walk to Reddock with Kliff following, then Javier's delivery BPANKRATZ31233 with Kliff standing where he stops behind the hero (follow distance 4.5 m). Its CondOwnerNearEntity=Kliff is 20 m in G3 (gCInfo_PS::GetDistOwnerToEntity scales the distance to an NPC by 0.25); ours took 5 m and the topic never came (owner's save: Kliff 6.6 m from Javier).
steps: log -- the owner's path: Topork's duel first (BPANKRATZ31298, Topork_Duell), Kliff_FreeHim is offered after it (BPANKRATZ31299 > 31301)
log -- the owner's path: 'wait here' on the way, then 'follow me' again (CP SlaveJoin: not led, or led and waiting)
log -- lead Kliff to Javier (99 m straight, ~134 m path), no bring, Kliff stands where following leaves him
notes: The hero walks up to Javier himself (walkto near=2) and Kliff, a Slave member, stops at his follow distance ((slot 0 + 3) x 1.5 m = 4.5 m) behind him: about 6-7 m from Javier, as in the owner's save018 (Kliff 703.2,-121.0, Javier 708.3,-116.7, 6.6 m). fix-105 (r40: Kliff 17 m away): the escort stopped 15 m short on the terrace above Javier and walkto went the straight line, over the 13.6 m drop (walked 8 m in 2 s, not grounded); Kliff, following on the NavMesh, had to go round. The escort now leads along the NavMesh path to 3 m. Before fix-100 `expect available:BPANKRATZ31233` failed there (CondOwnerNearEntity 5 m); the generated sideq_reddock_01 hid it with `bring Javier near=npc:Kliff dist=1`.
